notes: Cinder & Salt, an invented Copenhagen wood-fire and fermentation kitchen. One self-contained index.html: hand-drawn SVG wordmark, dish and hearth illustrations, a procedural ember canvas, generated Web Audio ambience, a 39-item searchable menu with dietary filters, a persistent basket with collection checkout, and a reservation flow using Copenhagen-time hours, special dates and unavailable slots. Orders and bookings are client-side only; there is no backend. Google Fonts is the sole optional external request, with a full offline fallback stack.
